description:
Confirm a booking request

Confirms a booking that waits for the host (status `pending`). The calendar provider then informs the attendee as it always does. Only calendars with booking requests support this (Cal.com). The others answer 422 `not_supported`.

bookingId.description: The `id` of the booking as GET /integrations/bookings returns it.

name: confirm_booking
